notes: Files Z.ai writes on chat.z.ai now land in your project. Z.ai works in its own sandbox on the website; v1.0.33 reads those files back (the site's tool-call records and its per-message versions storage) and syncs them into the project with a review card: per-file diff, Apply / Apply all / Reject, a new Keep both choice for conflicting files (saves the Z.ai copy as name-zai-1.ext, never overwrites silently), and an honest result card - Files synced to project: N with Open buttons, Files Z.ai wrote but could NOT be read: N, binary files skipped with a message, and an amber warning (never a green finish) when Z.ai wrote files but none could be read. A manual Sync files from Z.ai button sits in the project chat above the composer, so you can pull files after the site finished. The reply protocol now teaches Z.ai to write WHOLE files with their relative paths and to list every file it changed; commands (RUN) stay optional and a reply without them is never a failure. Timeout rework: the app keeps waiting while the site is still generating (stop indicator, streaming text, or tool activity all count as progress); it times out only after 300s of NO page change, with a 30-minute absolute cap, and a timeout now shows Still running on the website with Re-read reply / Sync files now buttons instead of a dead failure. Nothing new runs at startup.
